t: You're looking at Seven Ages of Man, a sculpture made by Richard Kindersley. Kindersley, who lived from 1939 to 2025, was a British typeface designer, stone letter carver and sculptor. That mix of letters and sculpture is worth keeping in mind as you look. The title points to the idea of life divided into seven stages, so see whether you can pick out how the piece marks them. I don't have more detail on its making, so let your own eyes lead.
